item_name: Rothco Insulated Side Zip Tactical Boot - 8 Inch
item_short_desc: Rothco's Insulated Tactical Boots feature our Thermoblock™ insulation for warmth and are also waterproof making them the ideal tactical boot for extreme weather conditions.
description: Rothco's Insulated Tactical Boots feature our Thermoblock™ insulation for warmth and are also waterproof, making them the ideal tactical boot for extreme weather conditions. In addition, the boots feature a full grain leather vamp, action leather upper, and pigskin leather collar for durability. The gusseted side zipper and tongue, as well as a steel shank, offer a comfortable fit, while rustproof hardware and speed laces make the tactical boots easy to lace up. A slip-resistant sole provides optimal grip when in the field.
